description: A planned mix of outcomes for watching the sabotage harness without building anything: passes, failures, runs that overrun the bound, and one patch that does not build. Not part of any test; run it with tools/faux/run-faux-plan.ps1, which sweeps it in a throwaway repository -- see 'Faux runs' in tools/README-sabotage.md. Each entry's replace line is its plan.

sabotages.name: takes a second, then fails
sabotages.why: A slow failure, well under the default bound of 3 seconds.

sabotages.name: never ends
sabotages.why: A hang: killed at the bound, and reported as caught.

sabotages.name: sleeps past the bound, but is given more
sabotages.why: Over the sweep's bound and under this entry's own: a failure, not a hang.

sabotages.name: is refused by the build
sabotages.why: A patch that does not build, as a compile-time guard would refuse it.
